steps.what: List stored impact figures for engineering operations.
Develop the program to reduce environmental impacts and improve sustainability.
Review whether to implement the program on architecture activities.

tasks.design: Impact figures already stored for an engineering operation are listed from the {ERP}. The manager develops the program to reduce environmental impacts and decides whether to implement it on architecture activities. An operation with no figure id is not listed. The list does not write the program.
tasks.previous_blocker: Impact figures were reassembled before each program discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored impact figure can be listed before the manager writes the program.
tasks.still_hard: An impact the stored figures do not capture, such as a method the site has not measured.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can see a low figure that is an unmeasured impact, not a success.
tasks.altitude: Stored impact figures can be listed. The manager still develops the program and still decides whether to implement it.

reach.task: Read the stored impact figure, and still leave the program here.
reach.learn: The figure can be listed. The program stays here.

evidence.claim: An impact figure already stored for an operation can be listed. The list cannot develop or implement a sustainability program.
The manager decides whether to implement the program. A figure is not a permit and it does not reduce an impact by being listed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.

Fields: Operation id and figure id, produced by the measurement file. An operation with no figure is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the measurement file the firm already keeps. Do not claim a reduction the file has not measured.
unknowns: Which operations already have a stored figure.
research_questions: What share of programs start from a stored figure?

already_counted.description: The manager still develops the program.
The manager still decides whether to implement it.

incremental.description: The manager documents an impact the file did not measure.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing impact figures already stored for the operation. It disappears when the figure is missing and the manager documents it. Developing and implementing the program stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored activity records for the engineering work.
Evaluate environmental impacts of the engineering or architecture activities.
Record impacts of research and development activities.

tasks.design: Activity records already stored for the engineering work are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager evaluates the environmental impacts of the engineering, architecture, or research and development activities. An activity with no id is not listed. The list does not evaluate the impact.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity records were gathered by asking each lead what the last month had included.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored activity record can be listed before the manager evaluates the impact.
tasks.still_hard: An impact that is not in the activity record.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can tell a recorded activity from the impact it leaves.
tasks.altitude: Stored activity records can be listed. The manager still evaluates the environmental impact.

reach.role: Brownfield Redevelopment Specialists and Site Managers
reach.task: Pass the stored activity record, and still leave the impact evaluation here.
reach.learn: The record can be listed. The evaluation stays here.

evidence.claim: An activity record already stored can be listed. The list cannot evaluate the environmental impact.
The manager makes the evaluation. A record of an activity is not a finding that the impact is acceptable.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Activity id, produced by the project log. An activity with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the project log the firm already keeps. Do not treat a listed activity as a cleared impact.
unknowns: Which impacts are outside the log.
research_questions: What share of evaluations start from a stored activity?
Which impacts have no activity record?

already_counted.description: The manager still evaluates the impact.
The manager still records the finding.

incremental.description: The manager adds an activity the log did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing activity records already stored. It disappears when the activity is missing and the manager adds it. Evaluating the environmental impact stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List work orders already logged for facilities or equipment.
Direct installation, testing, operation, maintenance, or repair.
Record the equipment state after the site visit.

tasks.design: Work orders already logged for facilities or equipment are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager directs installation, testing, operation, maintenance, or repair on site. An order with no id is not listed. The list does not install or repair anything.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager arrived on site and learned the work order was for a different piece of equipment.
tasks.enabler_now: A logged work order can be listed before the manager goes to site.
tasks.still_hard: Equipment that is not as the order describes, and a test that can only be done in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can stop a test the order calls routine when the room is not ready.
tasks.altitude: Logged work orders can be listed. The manager still directs installation, testing, maintenance, and repair on site.

reach.task: Read the logged work order, and still direct the installation on site.
reach.learn: The order can be listed. The visit stays here.

evidence.claim: A work order already logged for a facility or a piece of equipment can be listed. The list cannot install, test, or repair it.
The manager directs the work on site. A work order is not the installation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Order id, produced by the work-order log. An order with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the log the firm already keeps. The manager carries the visit.
unknowns: Which tests require the manager on site.
research_questions: What share of visits start from a logged order?
Which repairs are not on an order?

already_counted.description: The manager still directs the work on site.
The manager still records the equipment state.

incremental.description: The manager confirms an order the log did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing work orders already logged for facilities or equipment. It disappears when the order is missing and the manager confirms it. Directing installation, testing, and repair stays on site with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List technologies already logged for this development.
Identify environmental threats or opportunities associated with the launch.
Record the threat the manager will act on.

tasks.design: Technologies already logged for the development are listed from {PROJECT}. The manager identifies environmental threats or opportunities associated with the launch. A technology with no id is not listed. The list does not name the threat.
tasks.previous_blocker: The technology was described again in each launch meeting before anyone named a threat.
tasks.enabler_now: A logged technology can be listed before the manager looks for the threat.
tasks.still_hard: A threat that is not a property of the logged technology.
tasks.human_edge: The manager can name an opportunity the technology list does not contain.
tasks.altitude: Logged technologies can be listed. The manager still identifies the threat or the opportunity.

reach.role: Biofuels/Biodiesel Technology and Product Development Managers
reach.task: Pass the logged technology, and still leave the threat with the manager.
reach.learn: The technology can be listed. The threat stays here.

evidence.claim: A technology already logged for a development can be listed. The list cannot identify an environmental threat or opportunity.
The manager names the threat. A technology log is not a decision to launch.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An architectural and engineering manager in a mid-size European firm. A list does not approve a design, place a person, or issue a contract.
Fields: Technology id, produced by the development log. A technology with no id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the development log the firm already keeps. Do not treat a listed technology as cleared to launch.
unknowns: Which threats are outside the log.
research_questions: What share of threat reviews start from a logged technology?
Which threats have no technology id?

already_counted.description: The manager still identifies the threat.
The manager still records the threat to act on.

incremental.description: The manager logs a technology the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing technologies already logged for the development. It disappears when the technology is missing and the manager logs it. Identifying the environmental threat or opportunity stays with the manager.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still writes the sustainability program, still evaluates the environmental impact, and still directs installation and repair. A stored figure or a logged work order can be listed first. The manager still names the threat.
reach: Chief sustainability officers read a stored impact figure and still write the program, and this job learns the figure is not the program.
Construction managers direct installation on site, and this job learns a work order is not the visit.
skills_to_grow: Evaluate the environmental impact, and do not treat a stored figure as the finding.
Direct installation, testing, and repair on site.
role.ambitious_version: Stored impact figures and logged work orders are ready first. The program, the impact judgement, the site visit, and the threat stay with the manager.
